book.name: Sinale
book.title: Qapiya wei Xuk wei Sinaleyeiw o

content: Konilias taxe Petele
Nanghei Sisalia eno tambiy ti mi dei inyon eno lei Konilias, inyon beyeiv wei xel 100 vevekyeiw o wei xel mi taxe bei vevekyeiw qendu ti wei beyeeng Itali yo.
Moxo lis nipapu mi yaleeng me betiwou Anutu teyei lek bouk tambak, me mi vind xel wei kanyo yo. De taxombouk eno mi zeimema wou Anutu.
Bouk ti lek seivma yal wei soukeing eno Konilias mapekwi me yei bei Anutu xe angela ti lam di neil qayeeng wou e me neil embei, “Konilias!”

Konilias yaleeng me doma wou e, Moxo teling, “Tambiy Ngandoung, inye va?” Angela lewexe, “Wa xe zeimeing me vineing wei wang mi wong wou xel kanyo eno la gheyapu wou Anutu manghalus nambei da wei woueing nalei en o.
Om wong moux valu la Jopa me qou tambiy tiwei lei Simon o me loum. Wei xel mi taxe e lei nge eno Petele.
Moxo mindei is Simon tambiy wei mi wo xuk lek manghaxo ninavi yo, wei e beeng di yeip wou mamileeng nenyawes o.”
Ka angela luk is e woy dom la, woyom Konilias taxe e xe xukxe yuw me xel vevekyeiw eno ti wei mi betiwou Anutu me mi yeiwou xow woy en xuk wei Konilias o.
Moxo neil wou lal en lulul sapa wei tyip on dom wong lal la Jopa.
Petele manghalus pekwi me yei
Lek bouk nge yanyeing wei seivma evlek eno tambiy yal on la tyip paviy beyeeng ngandoung Jopa, de Petele lek la xomek demi qetyei bei na zeim mema.
Moxo maxepya om embei gya lul yaeing valu, ka xel di yeiwou lul yaeing, eno moxo manghalus pekwi me yei.
Moxo yei tyoung gheyapu tax me lulti nambei qaeing ngandoung ti, wei xel byex yis eivek nenyawes vey de wong e tei lam lek tembuing.
Eivek qaeing on eno pup en leliy leliy wei vaxa vey eno lam eivek tiyon me ingwei mi yelek tembuing me menek menek o.
Woyom vya ti neil wou e, “Petele, qandi, de leis me wa.”
Petele neil elox bei, “Se teyei, Tambiy Ngandoung! A se mi xa lul wei nilul o nilaxes o ti.”
Woyom vya tine neil wou e luyuw, “Wa se taxe lulti nilaxes wei Anutu wong e wo vako yo.”
Tine wo luyal, de lutika eno qaeing ngandoung tiyon leklox me la tyoung gheyapu.
Kalekom Petele di wounalei ngenong en ingwei manghalus pekwi me yei eno qes, de moux yal wei Konilias wong lal la eno la yeiwou Simon beeng om lal nale wou tete mya.
Xel taxe la me teling bei, “Simon tiwei lei nge bei Petele eno toundei inye?”
Ka Petele nanghei di wounalei en ingwei manghalus pekwi me yei vati yo, eno Laweeng Vambuing neil wou e bei, “Simon, moux yayal di yimexe wang o.
Om qandi me lep me la xonei, wa seng bounaleim ngenong en laeing is lal, en a wong lal lak.”
Petele la xonei me neil wou lal, “A tiwei mal ghe di wimexe eno inye. Mal ghe lam en va?”

Moux yal on neil elox, “Konilias beyeiv wei xel vevek o wong ghal a lam. E yon bombek me tambiy wei mi yaleeng en Anutu yo, e tiwei xel Yudayeiw dalus mi wevek e xeinghembi yo. Angela vambuing neil wou bei wang na e xe xomek en kandek e ngo vati wei wambei neil o.”

Woyom Petele neil wou moux yal on me qou lal me la eivek beeng me yeiteyei lal boukeing tiyon. Petele la Konilias beeng Nge yanyeing eno Petele la is lal me xel wongeingis valu nanghei Jopa eno la is.
Yanyeing eno xel la tyip Sisalia. Konilias di wou kwa en xel, me taxe nipapu dalus me gweleeng yeiw wei mindei paviy e yo me xel qeku la toundei.
Ka Petele la eivek xomek, Konilias la pelong e me ev vaxa qatu eivek de wo lalo wou e.
Ekom Petele wong e nale ghey. De neil wou e, “Nale, a maxow ne moux bandaing.”
De Petele la lalei me luk is e, me yei xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung ti di qekuma.

Moxo neil wou xel, “Xam venaxow ghe woulek e wo nimza bei, Inyei se la teyei lek xa xe petieing bei Yudayeiw ti na mendei is xel amba o na paviy xel. Ekom Anutu talex wou ay bei a se taxe xelti bei e nilul o e nilaxes.
Om a se pyalek wa vyam wei wang taxe ay yo. Qe a lam teyei lek wa vyam, om ambei teling xam bei xam ghe taxe ay en va?”
Konilias lewexe, “Bouk vey lak veil eno a toundei eivek bang me na zeimemang lek seivma tine, lek seivma yal wei soukeing o. Lutika eno tambiy ti byex teimb wei teltyip eno nale wou a manghalus
me neil, ‘Konilias, Anutu ngo wa xe zeimeing mema me wounalei en wa xe wongeing wei wang mi wong wou xel kanyo yo.
Om wong xelti la Jopa en Simon wei xel mi taxe lei nge bei Petele yo. Moxo la toundei eivek xomek wei Simon wei mi wo xuk lek manghaxo ninavi yo, wei e xe xomek toundei wou mamileeng nenyawes o.’

Om a wong tambiy yal lak lutika, dom inye nimza bei wang lam. Gweimbeeng wei xe xouing dalus a toundei inye wou Anutu manghalus bei na ngo wou lul sapa wei Tambiy Ngandoung peti wou wang bei wa neil wou xa yo.”
Petele neil xoulek eivek Konilias beeng
Woyom Petele embei baluk: “Gweimbeeng a woulek zonghek bei inyon Anutu se mi talex lalei vineing wou xelti venaxow
qe mi lewexe lek xomaxoneing wei lam anghei tembuing tambak nei me mi yaleeng en e me mi wong vati wei bombek o.
Xam ghe woulek qayeeng wei Anutu wong ela wou xomaxoneing wei Israel o, me neil Xoulek Nimza wei lalei vevopeing wei lam eivek Yesu Kilisi yo, e tiwei wo Tambiy Ngandoung en lul dalusateiv o.
Xam ghe woulek lul tambak woy wei belup ela teyei lek tembuing sapa wei Yudia nei. Dekakom Yoan neil qayeeng wei lipekeing o. Lul ne qandi tax eivek Galili.

Xam ghe woulek bei Anutu beyal Yesu wei Nasaret o me wong Laweeng Vambuing me nikanzek wou e, me xam ghe woulek ingwei e la ghavinenyeing me vind xel me wong xel dalus wei mindei xeinghembi eivek nikanzek wei tambiy mapetok o wo nimzalek, en nambei Anutu toundei is e.
“Xa xei lek mami en lul dalus wei Yesu wong eivek tembuing tambak wei Yudayeiw me eivek Yerusalem o. Xel leis e mey nangya ingwei xel teyu e lek xax o,
ekom Anutu piyexe e veil meyeing lek bouk yal, de lenghek lek bei xomaxoneing gyei e.
Xomaxoneing dalus on se yei e, qe xel wei yei eno inyon Anutu beyal xel wongeingis wei xa mi xa me na num is e gyeik ingwei qandi lek veil meyeing o.
E wong qayeeng nikanzek wou xa bei xa neil qayeeng wou xomaxoneing me na neil teyeimbei, e tambiy tiwei Anutu beyal bei e zeim qayeeng wei mapieing me meyeing o.
Poropet dalus neil e teyei bei xel dalus wei wongis e eno mi semaleeng xel xe sewokeing veil eivek Yesu lei.”
Ka Petele nanghei di neil qayeeng tine, Laweeng Vambuing lam axone lek xomaxoneing dalus wei ngo qayeeng ne yo.
Xel wongeingis wei ghuw nindnavi me lam is Petele eno etek en vineing wei Laweeng Vambuing qapyex elam lek xel wei bamba yo is.
En xel ngo ingwei xel on di luk eivek vya vya me sanghoxe Anutu yo. Woyom Petele neil,
“Eti teyeimbei bale zeyi xomaxoneing ne en ingwei xel embei zipek eivek memiing o? En xel qou Laweeng Vambuing nambei ingwei xey a qou ne.”
Om moxo wong qayeeng nikanzek wou xel bei, “Xel a qou lipekeing eivek Yesu Kilisi lei.” Woyom xel teling wou Petele bei e toumendei is xel bouk valu.
